report.clinical_summary: Patient diagnosed with HIV three years ago, currently on Triumeq. Reports occasional missed doses and drug holidays when feeling well. Experiences ongoing symptoms including headaches and fatigue. Currently worried about viral load becoming detectable again after being undetectable, which is causing significant anxiety and affecting daily functioning. Has developed good understanding of condition and importance of treatment, but struggles with consistency in adherence and managing anxiety about long-term outcomes.
